newsitem.title: USA: Q.E.P says it will get acquisition advice.
newsitem.headline: Q.E.P says it will get acquisition advice.

text.p: Q.E.P. Co Inc said it has retained the investment banking firm, Fahnestock & Co Inc, to advise it on future acquisitions that would be compatible with its business development strategies.
Fahnestock is a New York-based, full-service investment banking and brokerage firm which provides a broad range of financial and advisory services to emerging growth and middle market companies.
Q.E.P. Co Inc is a manufacturer, marketer and distributor of a broad line of specialty tool and related products for the home improvement market.
